text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More congratulations for President Hafez al-Assad on the occasion of 51st anniversary of evacuation of French forces from Syria.
- Talks with Israel in grave impasse, Palestinian leader says.
- Lebanese towns fired at by Israeli guns.
- Arab group achieves good results at the conference of the International Parliamentary Union.
- Cabinet briefed on regional political developments, reviews agricultural crops.
- Israeli criminal practices condemned at Beirut symposium.
- Parliament listens to the government's response over services issues.
